transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been really struggling with eating huge amounts of food in one sitting. It feels like I completely lose control during these times and just can't stop myself.

After these episodes, do you ever try to make up for them by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot? This helps me understand whether the eating episodes are followed by purging or other compensatory behaviors.
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or force myself to fast or over-exercise afterward. I just end up living with the guilt and discomfort.

Outside of the eating episodes, have you been feeling down most days or losing interest in things you usually enjoy for at least two weeks? This helps me tell whether depression may also be playing a major role.
I haven't really noticed feeling down or losing interest in things for that long. Honestly, my main concern is really just centered around my eating habits and how out of hand they've gotten.
How often have these eating episodes been happening, and for about how many months has this been going on?
These episodes have been happening about once a week on average. It's been going on like this for about a year now.

During these episodes, do you also find that you eat much more quickly than usual, eat until you feel uncomfortably full, eat when you’re not physically hungry, or eat alone because you feel embarrassed?

I definitely eat until I'm uncomfortably full, even when I'm not actually hungry, and I usually eat alone because I feel so embarrassed by it. I'm not really sure if I eat much faster than usual, but those other things definitely happen to me.
Do these binge-eating episodes cause you a lot of distress or upset? For example, do you feel very guilty, ashamed, or bothered by them?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in those terms of distress or guilt. I just know that the eating itself is what I'm struggling with the most.
When these episodes happen, do they feel upsetting or troublesome to you overall, even if you wouldn’t describe it exactly as guilt or shame?
I'm not really sure how to put it into words, and I haven't thought about it in terms of being upset or troubled. I'm just focused on trying to get the eating behavior itself under control.
Are your weight or body shape a major source of worry for you, or do they strongly affect how you feel about yourself?
I haven't really thought about my weight or body shape to be honest. That isn't really my main concern right now; I'm just focused on trying to get this eating behavior under control.
During these episodes, does it feel like you truly can’t stop eating or control what or how much you’re eating once you start?
Yes, absolutely. Once I start eating, it feels like a switch flips and I have no control whatsoever. It feels completely impossible to stop myself or regulate how much I am consuming.
Have these eating episodes been causing problems in your daily life, like affecting your work, relationships, or avoiding social situations?

Yes, I definitely avoid eating around others and prefer to eat alone because I feel so embarrassed about how much I'm eating, which has started to affect my social life. However, I'm not quite sure if it has heavily impacted my work or other relationships yet.
